info.title: CuiSharp.Tools - drive a CuiSharp app from the command line
info.description: Screenshot a CuiSharp app, print the controls of its last frame, and click or type into it - without a window, an agent or a test project.

options.name: --project
options.description: the app to run (a project file or its directory). Default: here

options.name: --app
options.description: run a published build instead of building

options.name: --frames
options.description: draw this many frames before the command

options.name: --stdin
options.description: read commands from stdin and print each answer, one process

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
only print the payload
Anything after `--` goes to the app.
